title: An Orbital Shaking Culture of Mammalian Cells in O-shaped Vessels to Produce Uniform Aggregates
protocol: Cultivate HEK293 cells in Dulbecco's modified Eagle medium with 10% fetal bovine serum and 1% non-essential amino acids.
Adjust the pH of the culture medium to 6.8 - 7.6.
Dissociate the cells with a 0.25% trypsin-ethylenediaminetetraacetic acid solution (trypsin-EDTA).
Resuspend dissociated cells in 2 - 5 mL of culture medium.
Filter the cell suspension through a cell strainer (40 µm).
Count the number of cells by trypan blue staining and automatic cell counter.
Prepare 20 mL of the cell suspension at a concentration of 2.0 x 10^5 cells/mL.
Connect the inlet of the O-shaped bag to a clamped 50 mL syringe without a plunger.
Pipette the prepared cell suspension into the O-shaped bag through the clamped syringe.
Replace the first clamped syringe with a clean syringe.
Add 55 mL of clean air through the clean syringe to expand the bag completely.
Clamp the inlet tube and then close the inlet.
Remove the clamp from the tube.
Incubate the cells in the O-shaped bag by shaking them at 45 rpm in conditions of 37 °C and 5% CO2.
Transfer the cell suspension into a 50 mL tube through the inlet.
Centrifuge it for 2 min at 200 x g at room temperature.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Add 20 mL of culture medium and resuspend the cells.
Add the resuspended cells to the O-shaped bag by following steps 2.4 - 2.7.
Incubate the cells in the O-shaped bag by shaking them at 45 rpm in conditions of 37 °C and 5% CO2.
Transfer the cell suspension into a 50 mL tube through the inlet.
Wash the inside of the bag with 20 mL of calcium/magnesium-free phosphate buffered saline [PBS(-), pH = 7.4 - 7.6].
Drain the contents into a tube to collect the remaining cells from the bag.
Centrifuge the collected cell suspension for 3 min at 200 x g at room temperature.
Aspirate the supernatant.
Add 10 mL of PBS(-) and wash the aggregates.
Centrifuge them for 3 min at 200 x g at room temperature.
Aspirate the supernatant to collect the aggregates.
Add 4 mL of PBS and 1 mL of trypsin.
Incubate them with the aggregates for 10 min at 37 °C to dissociate the cells for counting.
Cut out the bottom of a 60 mm or 35 mm dish with a hot knife and utilize it as an inner dish.
Put the 60 mm dish upside-down on the center of a 100 mm dish.
Dry the O-shaped dish for a few days.
Sterilize the O-shaped dish by gamma ray or ethylene oxide gas.
